headline: EPS declines both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Jyoti CNC Automation reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₹2.51, down 36.9% q/q and down 20.1% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ₹2.51 fell 36.9% sequentially from ₹3.98 and 20.1% year-over-year from ₹3.14. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
